payload.answer: [hard] Concurrency changes failure semantics, and that is the actual work rather than the asyncio.gather. Today a hanging engine blocks everything visibly and in order; concurrently, one hung engine among four must not silently reduce the report to three. Per-engine timeout, and partial results that SAY they are partial. [hard] Output must stay deterministic -- engines reported in a stable order regardless of completion order, or the command becomes untestable and diffs become noise. [hard] One engine failing must not fail the others. [hard] Do not weaken any check to make it fast; correctness of the verdict is the point of the command. [hard] 100% branch coverage including the timeout and partial-result paths. [hard] Conventional Commits, feature branch into develop.
